description: Add heat pump power field (moc_pompy_ciepla_kw) to ProfilZuzycia and implement price-optimized hourly distribution for dynamic tariffs. For dynamic tariffs (G11f_dynamiczna, G11_dynamiczna), concentrate heat pump consumption in cheapest RCE hours instead of spreading evenly across 24h. For G11 (fixed price), keep the existing even distribution.
steps: Step 1: Add moc_pompy_ciepla_kw field to ProfilZuzycia dataclass in backend/services/energy_profile.py (default 0.0). This represents the electrical power of the heat pump in kW.
Step 2: Update stworz_profil_z_danych() in backend/services/energy_profile.py to read moc_pompy_ciepla_kw from input data dict.

Step 3: Update oblicz_profil_godzinowy() signature to accept optional taryfa parameter (default None or 'G11'). When taryfa is one of the dynamic tariffs AND moc_pompy_ciepla_kw > 0, use price-optimized distribution for heat pump CO and CWU.

Step 4: Implement price-optimized heat pump logic: For each day, calculate daily heat demand (from monthly total / days_in_month). Determine how many hours the pump needs to run: hours_needed = ceil(daily_demand_wh / (moc_pompy_ciepla_kw * 1000)). Use pobierz_cene_rce(miesiac, godzina) to get prices for all 24 hours of that day, sort by price ascending, and assign heat pump consumption to the cheapest hours_needed hours. Distribute evenly across those hours (daily_demand_wh / hours_needed per hour).
Step 5: For G11 tariff (or when moc_pompy_ciepla_kw is 0), keep existing PROFIL_GODZINOWY_POMPY_CO distribution unchanged.
Step 6: Update handle_energy_profile() in backend/api/handlers.py to pass taryfa parameter from request data to oblicz_profil_godzinowy(). The frontend already sends taryfa selection.
Step 7: Add moc_pompy_ciepla_kw input field to frontend/pages/energy-profile.html in the heat pump section (section 3). Show it when pompa-co checkbox is checked. Default value 3 kW, range 1-15 kW.
Step 8: Update frontend JavaScript in energy-profile.html to include moc_pompy_ciepla_kw and taryfa in the POST request body to /api/energy-profile.

Step 9: Add/update tests in backend/tests/test_energy_profile.py: test that with dynamic tariff + moc_pompy_ciepla_kw set, heat pump consumption is concentrated in fewer hours (not spread across 24h). Test that total annual consumption remains the same. Test that G11 tariff still uses even distribution.
acceptance_criteria: For dynamic tariffs with moc_pompy_ciepla_kw > 0, heat pump hours are concentrated in cheapest RCE hours
For G11, heat pump distribution remains unchanged (PROFIL_GODZINOWY_POMPY_CO)
Total annual heat pump consumption remains correct (not inflated or deflated)
Frontend has moc_pompy_ciepla_kw input field visible when pompa-co is checked
All existing tests still pass plus new tests for optimization logic
